title: 第3226章 到底是谁冥顽不灵第3225章 活捉陈长安
slug: 被女帝师父嫌弃的我竟举世无敌
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：被女帝师父嫌弃的我，竟举世无敌第一卷：默认第3226章到底是谁冥顽不灵（..la）动手？
凌霄宫以及天圣宫宫主两个人都是摇了摇头。
“不急，他已经出现在这里，插翅难逃，何必急于这一时。”
“难道你们就不好奇，这个陈长安到底是什么人，到底怎么得罪了圣灵一族？”
“圣灵一族为什么一直都要找到这个人？”
闻听此言，三神教的三位教主也是满脸疑惑，因为他们所有人都不知道这其中的原因是什么。
“正好趁着这个机会，咱们先问问。”
“如果真的有什么惊天秘密，咱们也能够提前知晓。”
“若是真的能够改变我们的命运，以后这天衍大陆究竟是谁做主，可就说不定了。”
“这……真的会有这样的机会吗？”
“你们也不想想，圣灵一族这样的存在，都对这个陈长安如此重视，说明他身上一定隐藏着什么让圣灵一族感兴趣的东西。”
“否则的话，为什么要活捉？”
“有道理！”
“那咱们还真的得多留他一会，先问问清楚了。”
当他们再次看向陈长安的时候，眼神已经发生了转变。
面前的这个人，并不只是功劳那么简单，甚至有可能改变他们所有人的命运。
“陈长安，我很好奇，圣灵一族为什么对你这么在意。”
“这其中是否有什么秘密？”
“如果你肯说出来的话，说不定，我们会放你一马。”
“没错，只要足够有诱惑力，我们也未必就真的要将你带给圣灵一族。”
听到这些人的话，陈长安笑着说道“怎么？想要从我身上获得什么秘密，获取到什么好处？”
“为此，你们都不惜背叛主子了？”
“果然啊，这天底下什么事情都是有价值的。”
“足够多的诱惑和威胁，就可以让你们放弃一切原则。”
对于陈长安的嘲讽，他们并不在意，喜欢说那就说几句，反正身上掉不下一块肉。
“陈长安，这些没用的废话还是少说吧。”
“你最好想清楚，该说什么，不该说什么。”
“你的机会不多，你最好把握住。”
机会？
“你们不过就是贪图我身上的秘密，怀疑是不是有什么让圣灵一族动心的东西。”
“可是你们这个算盘打错了，圣灵一族想要抓住我，和你们的情况是一样的。”
“他们也不过是接收到了别人的指令，帮助别人做事罢了。”
“你们是狗，他们……也是！”
听到陈长安的话，二宫三神教的人明显不信。
圣灵一族是什么样的存在？
那可是十大圣族之一，真正站在鸿蒙天顶端的存在。
谁能够指使他们做事？疯了不成？就算是其他圣族也没有这个能力啊。
“陈长安，这话你自己信吗？”
“不要在这里跟我们浪费时间。”
“最好赶紧说出来，否则我们真的要对你不客气了。”
“不客气？”
“那我倒是想要看看，你们是如何不客气的。”
“哼，敬酒不吃吃罚酒，那我就让你知道知道。”
话音未落，凌霄宫宫主看了一眼身后之人，对方心领神会，直接向着陈长安冲了过去。
“还真是看不起我啊。”

The masters of Lingxiao Palace and Tiansheng Palace both shook their heads.
"Don't worry, he has already appeared here and there is no way to escape, so why rush at this moment."
"Aren't you curious, who is this Chen Chang'an, and how did he offend the Holy Spirit clan?"
"Why do the Holy Spirit clan keep finding this person?"
After hearing this, the three leaders of the Three Gods Religion also looked puzzled, because none of them knew the reason for this.
"Just taking this opportunity, let's ask first."
"If there really is any shocking secret, we can know it in advance."
"If it can really change our destiny, we may not know who will be in charge of Tianyan Continent in the future."
"Is...is there really such a chance?"
"Don't even think about it. The fact that existences like the Holy Spirit Clan attach so much importance to Chen Changan means that there must be something hidden in him that interests the Holy Spirit Clan."
"Otherwise, why should we be captured alive?"
"That makes sense!"
"Then we really need to keep him for a while longer and ask clearly first."
When they looked at Chen Changan again, their eyes had changed.
The person in front of them is not just a meritorious person, he may even change the fate of all of them.
"Chen Chang'an, I'm very curious as to why the Holy Spirit clan cares so much about you."
"Is there any secret in this?"
"If you are willing to speak out, maybe we will let you go."
"Yes, as long as you are tempting enough, we may not really bring you to the Holy Spirit Clan."
Hearing what these people said, Chen Changan smiled and said, "What? What secrets and benefits do you want to get from me?"
"For this reason, you are not willing to betray your master?"
"Sure enough, everything in this world is valuable."
"Enough temptations and threats can make you give up all principles."
They didn't care about Chen Chang'an's ridicule. They just said a few words if they liked. Anyway, they wouldn't lose a piece of flesh.
"Chen Chang'an, it's better to stop talking about these useless nonsense."
"You'd better think clearly about what to say and what not to say."
"You don't get many chances, you better seize them."
Opportunity?
"You are just coveting my secrets, wondering if there is something that could tempt the Holy Spirit family."
"But your calculation is wrong. The Holy Spirit clan wants to catch me, and the situation is the same as yours."
"They just received instructions from others and helped others do things."
"You are dogs, and so are they...!"
After hearing what Chen Changan said, the people of the Ergong Sanshen Sect obviously didn't believe it.
What kind of existence is the Holy Spirit family?
That is one of the ten great saint clans, the one who truly stands at the top of Hongmengtian.
Who can tell them what to do? Are you crazy? Even other saints don’t have this ability.
"Chen Changan, do you believe this?"
"Don't waste your time with us here."
"Better say it quickly, otherwise we're really going to be rude to you."
"You're welcome?"
"Then I would like to see how rude you are."
"Huh, if you don't eat the toast, you'll be punished with a drink, then I'll let you know."
Before he finished speaking, the Lord of Lingxiao Palace glanced at the person behind him. He understood and rushed towards Chen Changan.
"You really look down on me."
